# AI Chatbot

An AI Chatbot is the simplest conversational app: a prompt-driven chat app that answers from your instructions and connected knowledge. It has no tools, so every reply is a single model call grounded in your content. It's the quickest way to put an FAQ or documentation assistant in front of users.

## When to use it

| Use an AI Chatbot when… | Use something else when… |
|---|---|
| Answers come from your instructions and documents. | The agent must look things up or take action in other systems — use an [Autonomous Agent](/docs/build/autonomous-agent). |
| You want fast, predictable, low-cost replies. | You need branching by intent or multi-step logic — use an [Agent Flow](/docs/build/agent-flow). |
| You're prototyping and want to test prompts and knowledge quickly. | The conversation must follow a fixed script — see [Multi-prompt Agent](/docs/build/multi-prompt-agent). |

## Create a chatbot

Open **Conversational Apps › AI Chatbot**, click **Create from Blank**, enter an **App Name** and click **Create**. The app opens on the configuration canvas.

## Configure it

The editor works like the [Autonomous Agent](/docs/build/autonomous-agent) editor — node cards across the canvas, a dock with **Configurations** and **Agent Settings**, and **Preview**, **Logs** and **Publish Changes** in the header — with these differences:

| Node | In an AI Chatbot |
|---|---|
| **Trigger** | Same: input variables plus system variables. |
| **Instructions** | The system prompt. There is no **Knowledge Prompt** or **Tool Prompt**. |
| **Knowledge** | **Select reference Knowledge**, plus a **Retrieval Setting** button for **Multi-path retrieval** options such as **Top K**, **Score Threshold** and a rerank model. (Autonomous Agents don't have these settings.) |
| **Tools** | Not available. |
| **Vision** | Same **Vision Settings**. |
| **AI Model** | The model and its parameters (called **AI Agent** in an Autonomous Agent). **Debug as Multiple Models** compares up to 4 models. |
| **Output** | Informational. |

A card shows **Needs setup** when **Instructions** is empty or no model is selected.

### Feature cards

In **Agent Settings**, the chatbot offers the same feature cards: **Conversation Opener**, **Follow-up**, **Citations and Attributions**, **Content moderation** and **Annotation Reply** (the last two aren't shown on self-serve workspaces). There are no **Agent Mode** or **Maximum Iterations** settings, because the chatbot doesn't call tools.

### Example instructions

```text title="Instructions"
You are the help assistant for Brightline Dental.
Answer questions about opening hours, services, insurance and aftercare
using only the knowledge provided. If the answer isn't there, say you're
not sure and give the front desk number: (555) 010-2233.
Keep answers to three sentences or fewer. Never give medical diagnoses.
```

See [Writing instructions](/docs/build/instructions) for more patterns.

## Test and publish

Use **Preview** to chat with the draft, then click **Publish Changes**. Call the chatbot with [Chat Completions](/docs/api/chat-completions) (streaming or blocking) or put it on any [channel](/docs/channels).

## Switch to Workflow Orchestrate

When a chatbot outgrows its fixed layout — you need branching, API calls or tools — you can convert it to a canvas flow instead of rebuilding it.

1. On the **AI Chatbot** list page, open the app card's menu and choose **Switch to Workflow Orchestrate**.
2. Enter a name for **The app copy to be created**.
3. Optionally tick **Delete the original app**.
4. Click **Start switch**.

A new copy of the app is created as a canvas-based flow with your instructions, model and knowledge carried over. The copy can't be switched back.

<Callout type='warning'>
  Channels and API keys stay attached to the original app. After switching, publish the new copy, create a key for it and reassign channels. Don't tick **Delete the original app** until the copy is live.
</Callout>

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Answers are generic and ignore your documents | Attach the knowledge base on the **Knowledge** card, confirm it finished indexing, and check [Retrieval](/docs/knowledge/retrieval) settings. |
| The chatbot makes up answers | Tell it in **Instructions** to answer only from the provided knowledge and what to say when it doesn't know. Turn on **Citations and Attributions** to check sources. |
| You need it to look something up in another system | Chatbots can't call tools. Use an Autonomous Agent or switch to a flow. |
